title: Align Work Map writer and recovery control-plane contracts

phases.objective: Realign repository contracts, regression tests, and operator documentation with the current split between a trusted authorization/dispatch control plane and a workflow_dispatch-only sole Work Map writer.

e2e_journeys.actor: trusted Work Map recovery dispatcher and sole remote Work Map writer
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: An authorized, current, same-repository pull request requires generated Work Map repair.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The non-writer recovery control plane consumes one-time authorization and dispatches the workflow_dispatch-only writer with the exact branch head; the writer alone may generate and publish docs/work-maps changes, then dispatch verification.
steps: Validate the recovery control plane from trusted default-branch workflow code without candidate checkout or Work Map generation.
Require an open, ready, same-repository pull request targeting main and current with main.
Consume the one-time authorization marker and verify removal.
Dispatch Spec Kit Work Map Autofix with the exact branch and expected_head_sha.
Require the writer to pin local, remote, and pull-request identity before generation.
Generate twice, prove idempotency, reject changes outside docs/work-maps, and publish without force only to the governed work branch.
Dispatch CI and Work Map Integration against the resulting exact head.
assertions: Spec Kit Work Map Autofix exposes workflow_dispatch only.
Pull-request authorization, permission checks, marker consumption, and delegated-run observation belong to Spec Kit Work Map Autofix Recovery Dispatch.
The recovery dispatcher contains no checkout, Work Map generation, git commit, or git push path.
The writer rejects main and Production and requires exact local and remote head equality.
Docs Agent, OpenAPI Auto Sync, Work Map Integration, and the recovery dispatcher remain non-writers.
Pipeline connectivity validation reports no disconnected trigger, permission, command, producer, consumer, or writer-policy finding.
No provider, deployment, Production, runtime, credential, SQL, migration Apply, database, external-send, protected-ref, or force-push action is introduced.

phases.objective: Observe Docs Agent connectivity validation and the full CI manifest pass on the exact combined pull-request head.
Reject future drift that moves pull-request authorization back into the writer or grants a second Work Map remote writer.
This repository-control contract performs no runtime or provider canary.
This repository-control contract performs no Production, provider, deployment, or database mutation.
